title: studio(changes): the Changes panel shows no diff, marks a no-op draft as Update, and publish gives no confirmation
body:
**Filing gate ② — a product decision only the maintainer can make.**

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## Maintainer quick-read

The Changes panel lists only machine names with New/Update, and publishing gives no confirmation. Show what changed?

## Seen

- Changes: `OBJECT · 1 repairs_repair_ticket Update` — no field-level diff, label, or author.
- A draft identical to the live version is listed as *Update*.
- *Publish all* takes ~5 s and shows no success message; only the header text changes to "No drafts pending publish". The Form tab keeps the caption "Draft layout" after publish.

## Options

- **A** — per-item diff (added/removed/changed keys), hide no-op drafts, a "Published N items" toast.
- **B** — toast + hide no-ops only.
- **C** — status quo.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *changes panel diff no-op draft update publish feedback toast*: 4 hits (0 open, 4 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#2261 (closed) — closed 2026-07-05 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#2270): the same ask (diff in Changes panel + publish confirmation); this card = residual/regression
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#5801 (closed) — publish-state feedback family
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: changes panel diff · no-op draft update · publish success feedback
